pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with varied spatial area. Edges demonstrate relatively smooth pixel transitions with localized jaggedness. Patch density increases and size decreases towards the lower limbs and posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junctions are primarily trivalent. Path thickness is consistent across the dorsal and mid-flank regions, widening into more diffuse zones on the ventral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the neck and shoulder line, characterized by a dense brown mane.
